from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfitRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single company's net profit record extracted from a financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024 Q1'")
    profit_metric: str | None = Field(description="The specific profit type stated, e.g., 'Net profit attributable to shareholders', 'Consolidated net profit'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the profit")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount, e.g., 'CNY', 'million CNY', 'thousands CNY'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Brief verbatim text anchoring the figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profits: list[CompanyProfitRecord]
